summary: SQLite file-mode hardening must chmod the database, WAL and SHM files by path and never open/close them while the store holds connections.
reason: Opening and closing the database file from the application releases the process's POSIX fcntl locks held by live SQLite connections, so concurrent CLI processes (live-check probes, agents running commands in parallel) can write at the same time and corrupt the store; a 'database disk image is malformed' was observed during concurrent market/deal/yield runs.
validated_outcome: Concurrent stress (5 heavy commands x 6 rounds, 8 writers x 15 rounds) keeps PRAGMA integrity_check = ok.
